what: a percent of a whole as a 10x10 grid: its cells fill one by one, the number counts up beside it
use_when: an article states a percent with the % sign: 34% of the subscribers, 62% of the votes
avoid_when: the article gives a count, not a percent (stat), or the percent is computed rather than stated
rules: "share": one percent of a whole that an article states with the % sign (value 34 means 34%), never computed;
